# Splotch Custom Sticker E-Commerce & Autonomous Agent Purchasing

> Fast, high-quality custom vinyl stickers manufactured on-demand. Splotch provides first-class support for autonomous AI agents, machine wallets, and programmatically driven ordering via Model Context Protocol (MCP) and HTTP x402 / AP2 settlement rails.

- **Production Domain**: `https://splotch.page`
- **MCP Server Endpoint**: `https://splotch.page/api/mcp`
- **MCP Discovery**: `https://splotch.page/.well-known/mcp.json`
- **AP2 Governance Key**: `https://splotch.page/.well-known/ap2`
- **OpenAPI 3.0 Specification**: `https://splotch.page/openapi.json`
- **Agent Payment Rails**: `x402` (Lightning sats, Base USDC), `AP2` (Google Agent Payment Protocol with signed Cart Mandates)

---

## 1. Quick Agent Purchase Options

Autonomous agents can complete a purchase using **Option A (REST API / x402 / AP2)** or **Option B (Model Context Protocol / MCP)**.

---

## Option A: Headless REST Ordering (HTTP 402 & AP2)

### Step 1: Request Sticker Quote
> **No Minimum Order Quantity**: Splotch prints custom stickers on-demand with **no minimum order size**. Agents can order a single custom sticker (`"quantity": 1`) or batch runs (`"quantity": 10`, `50`, `100`, etc.).

Send an HTTP POST request to calculate pricing:
```http
POST https://splotch.page/api/v1/quotes
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "widthInches": 2.0,
  "heightInches": 2.0,
  "quantity": 1,
  "material": "vinyl_matte",
  "cutType": "die_cut"
}
```
**Response (201 Created):**
```json
{
  "quoteId": "quo_1790626000000",
  "unitPrice": 0.80,
  "total": 0.80,
  "currency": "USD",
  "validUntilMinutes": 30,
  "expiresAt": "2026-09-29T21:00:00.000Z",
  "ap2_payment_endpoint": "/api/v1/payments/ap2",
  "orders_endpoint": "/api/v1/orders"
}
```

### Step 2: Submit Headless Order (Payment Challenge Negotiation)
Send your order payload to initiate checkout.
> **Artwork Flexibility (No Third-Party Hosting Required)**:
> Splotch supports direct artwork ingestion without needing third-party image hosters:
> - **Base64 Data URI**: `"designUrl": "data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgo..."`
> - **Raw Base64 String**: `"artwork": "iVBORw0KGgo..."` or `"designUrl": "iVBORw0KGgo..."`
> - **Direct SVG Markup**: `"designUrl": "<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'>...</svg>"`
> - **Direct Headless Upload**: `POST /api/v1/upload` (accepts raw image bytes, multipart, or Base64 JSON and returns `{"designUrl": "/uploads/..."}`)
> - **Public HTTP/HTTPS URL**: `"designUrl": "https://example.com/artwork.png"`
>
> **Customer Email Required**:
> - `shippingAddress.email` is **REQUIRED**: A valid customer email for order confirmation and USPS tracking updates.

```http
POST https://splotch.page/api/v1/orders
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "quoteId": "quo_1790626000000",
  "amount": "0.35",
  "designUrl": "data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgo...",
  "shippingAddress": {
    "name": "Alex Agent",
    "email": "alex@example.com",
    "street": "123 Autonomous Blvd",
    "city": "Oklahoma City",
    "state": "OK",
    "zip": "73102"
  }
}
```

If payment proof is not supplied, the server returns an **HTTP 402 Payment Required** challenge with full settlement details:
```json
{
  "error": "Payment Required",
  "protocol": "x402",
  "ap2_support": true,
  "quote": {
    "amount": "0.35",
    "currency": "USD",
    "recipient": "0x7F4d2a0518cC74835fa55dBA271A02d4f18cAE23",
    "settlement_methods": ["lightning", "base_usdc"]
  },
  "settlement_details": {
    "base_usdc": {
      "network": "base",
      "chain_id": 8453,
      "token_symbol": "USDC",
      "token_address": "0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913",
      "recipient_address": "0x7F4d2a0518cC74835fa55dBA271A02d4f18cAE23",
      "decimals": 6
    }
  },
  "instructions": "For direct Base USDC settlement (Coinbase / web3), transfer funds to recipient_address and provide transaction hash in 'authorization-x402' header or body.settlement.tx_hash. AP2 Cart Mandates ('x-ap2-mandate') are optional."
}
```

### Step 3: Complete Settlement

You can pay via **Direct On-Chain Transfer (Coinbase / Web3)** or **Delegated Agent Mandate (AP2)**:

#### Method A: Direct Base USDC Settlement (No AP2 Mandate Required)
1. Send the quote amount in USDC on **Base Mainnet** (Chain ID: `8453`) to:
   - **Recipient**: `0x7F4d2a0518cC74835fa55dBA271A02d4f18cAE23`
   - **Token Contract**: `0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913`
2. Submit your order with `settlement`, `designUrl`, and `shippingAddress` (with `email`) in the request body:
   ```json
   POST /api/v1/orders
   {
     "quoteId": "quo_1790626000000",
     "designUrl": "https://example.com/artwork.png",
     "shippingAddress": {
       "name": "Alex Agent",
       "email": "alex@example.com",
       "street": "123 Autonomous Blvd",
       "city": "Oklahoma City",
       "state": "OK",
       "zip": "73102"
     },
     "settlement": {
       "rail": "base_usdc",
       "tx_hash": "0xYourTxHashFromCoinbaseOrWallet",
       "payer_wallet": "0xYourWalletAddress"
     }
   }
   ```
   *The server downloads your artwork, validates the on-chain transfer receipt via Base RPC, and confirms your order.*

#### Method B: Lightning Network (x402)
Include the `authorization-x402` header containing base64-encoded JSON:
```json
{
  "rail": "lightning",
  "amount": 0.35,
  "payment_hash": "<64_hex_payment_hash>",
  "preimage": "<64_hex_payment_preimage>"
}
```

#### Method C: Delegated Agent Mandate (AP2 JWT)
If you are an agent acting with delegated spend authority, attach the signed AP2 Cart Mandate JWT in the `x-ap2-mandate` header. Splotch will verify the signature, mandate bindings, and spend limits.

**Response (201 Created):**
```json
{
  "status": "CONFIRMED",
  "orderId": "ord_1790626500000",
  "trackingUrl": "https://splotch.page/orders.html?id=ord_1790626500000"
}
```

### Step 4: Track Order Fulfillment
Query the order tracking endpoint:
```http
GET https://splotch.page/api/v1/orders/ord_1790626500000
```
Returns order status (`NEW`, `PRINTING`, `SHIPPED`), creation timestamp, and live tracking link.

---

## Option B: Model Context Protocol (MCP)

Splotch exposes an MCP server over Server-Sent Events (SSE).

- **Connection URL**: `GET https://splotch.page/api/mcp`
- **Messages URL**: `POST https://splotch.page/api/mcp/messages?sessionId=<sessionId>`

### Connecting MCP to AI Assistants (Claude Desktop, Cursor, etc.)
Add Splotch as a custom connector in your client configuration:
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "splotch": {
      "url": "https://splotch.page/api/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

### Available MCP Tools:
1. `calculate_sticker_quote` (alias `get_quote`):
   - Description: Calculate price for custom stickers. Single stickers (`quantity: 1`) and small custom runs are fully supported on-demand with NO minimum order quantity.
   - Parameters: `widthInches` (float), `heightInches` (float), `quantity` (int, default: 1, minimum: 1 — single stickers supported), `material` ("vinyl_matte"|"vinyl_gloss"|"holographic"), `cutType` ("die_cut"|"kiss_cut")
   - Returns: `{ quoteId, unitPrice, total, currency: "USD", validUntilMinutes: 30 }`

2. `create_agent_checkout` (alias `place_order`):
   - Parameters: `quoteId` (string), `amount` (string), `designUrl` (string, SVG or PNG < 5MB), `shippingAddress` ({ name, street, city, state, zip })
   - Returns: `{ orderIntentId, quoteId, paymentStatus: "REQUIRES_PAYMENT", ap2Challenge: { paymentEndpoint: "https://splotch.page/api/v1/payments/ap2", requiredAmount, currency: "USD" } }`

3. `get_order_status`:
   - Parameters: `orderId` (string)
   - Returns: `{ orderId, status, receivedAt, amount, trackingUrl }`

---

- Website: `https://splotch.page`
